div.div: Temporal concentration: 80 % of ENS falls in evening peak hours (18:00-21:00) and morning ramp-up (06:00-08:00). Off-peak hours have adequate supply.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 580px; height: 1px; padding-top: 495px; margin-left: 720px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E2B3A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1E2B3A, #c0cbd8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Regional asymmetry: Northern Romanian regions hit hardest (farther from domestic hydro and baseload). Bucharest-area regions fare better due to local generation concentration.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 580px; height: 1px; padding-top: 533px; margin-left: 720px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E2B3A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1E2B3A, #c0cbd8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Neighbour impact: BG, HU, RS are unaffected (ENS = 0) -- the shock is unilateral (Romania only). Neighbours continue normal operation with their own supply.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 580px; height: 1px; padding-top: 571px; margin-left: 720px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E2B3A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1E2B3A, #c0cbd8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Capacity gap estimate: ~5.6 GWh/day average shortfall -→gt; need 1-2 large gas peaker plants (500 MW each) or ~2 GW of renewable + battery storage to close the gap.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(199, 213, 239), rgb(44, 56, 78));

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E2B3A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1E2B3A, #c0cbd8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Import dependency: Romania is 15-20 % import-dependent for meeting peak winter demand with current domestic capacity. Cross-border isolation alone, even without demand surge, would stress the system.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(237, 245, 255), rgb(21, 28, 36)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(199, 213, 239), rgb(44, 56, 78));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 298px; height: 1px; padding-top: 721px; margin-left: 358px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E2B3A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1E2B3A, #c0cbd8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Storage leverage: Evening-peak concentration (~80 % of ENS) makes batteries and pumped hydro disproportionately effective -- 2-4 GWh of storage could eliminate most blackout hours.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(237, 245, 255), rgb(21, 28, 36)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(199, 213, 239), rgb(44, 56, 78));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 298px; height: 1px; padding-top: 721px; margin-left: 680px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E2B3A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1E2B3A, #c0cbd8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Demand flexibility: Shifting 10-15 % of peak demand to off-peak hours dramatically reduces ENS. EV smart charging, industrial load shifting, and dynamic tariffs are high-leverage interventions.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(237, 245, 255), rgb(21, 28, 36)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(199, 213, 239), rgb(44, 56, 78));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 310px; height: 1px; padding-top: 721px; margin-left: 1002px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E2B3A;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1E2B3A, #c0cbd8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Interconnector value: Each GWh of import capacity is worth 12-15 M EUR under stress -- quantitative input for PCI cost-benefit analysis and TYNDP scenario development.

div.div: Results are deterministic envelopes for calibration, not probabilistic forecasts. The 2^5 orthogonal shock combination space supports full sensitivity sweeps; this case study is one cell.
